text:
alex: Quick syncwe need a governance checklist for Snowflake + Databricks + vector DB listings before a joint marketplace/press flow. Also need legal signoff timeline. Can we align dependencies and a target date?

maria: Yep. I'll draft a checklist. Must include: listing assets/screens, SKU mapping, telemetry opt-out language, SLA table, DPA/data-handling summary, sample onboarding flow, rollback instructions.

cheng: Tech notes: we should call out schema mapping for embeddings, connector packaging differences (Snowbridge vs DBX), and perf numbers for quantized models. FYI: sidecar adapter doesn't have automated API-key rotation yet  that's a security blocker for Snowflake cert.

samir: Partners care about entitlements & embargo. If we want external press mid-April we need partner + legal signoff by 2027-04-01. Is that realistic?

emily_legal: Emily (legal)  I'll request DPAs and data-handling addenda from Snowflake & Databricks today. Need explicit telemetry retention and opt-out fields in the spec. Initial review ETA 5 business days once we have the spec.

alex: @maria can you ping partner PMs for ETA? @partners-bot do we have an internal co-listing template?

partners-bot: Templates: https://internal.redwood/docs/marketplace-templates. Checklist v2: /drive/marketplace_checklist_v2.pdf. Note: include "partner entitlements" and "region residency" sections.

maria: Looping in partner PMs now. Draft checklist PR created for internal review (will post link). Planning a sync Tue 10am PT to finalize timeline.

cheng: Embeddings mapping example (add to docs):

```json
{
  "embedding_field": "redwood_embedding_v1",
  "dimension": 1536,
  "namespace": "docs",
  "metadata": {"source": "connector", "created_by": "redwood"}
}
```

cheng: Also add requirement: client-side key rotation + server-side least-privilege role for Snowbridge.

samir: Recommendation: staged release  marketplace listing first, monitor onboarding metrics for 7 days, then press/blog. Gives us time to catch issues.

emily_legal: Staged release preferred from legal side. Also require a rollback plan and points-of-contact for partners in case we need a takedown.

alex: Action items: maria draft checklist & ping partners (EOD). emily_legal request DPAs (today). cheng scope API-key rotation & estimate (EOW). samir draft announcement cadence & internal comms (tomorrow).

maria: PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/marketplace-listings/pulls/489. Reviewers: @emily_legal, @cheng, @samir. I'll update this thread after partner replies.

alex: Thanks all. If partners sign DPAs quickly we can target 2027-04-15 external announcement; otherwise we fallback to staged listing + 1-week press cadence. :rocket:

maria: Noted, keeping this thread as the single source of truth for timeline updates.
